playstyle.identity: Smolder is an infinitely scaling dragon ADC who gains stacks on Q hits. His abilities upgrade at stack thresholds, making him a late-game hypercarry.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q is a targeted ability that stacks on hit. W fires a slow zone. E dashes and flies over terrain briefly. R fires a huge wave globally. Q upgrades: 25 stacks adds explosion, 125 adds burn, 225 adds massive true damage. Farm Q stacks for scaling.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Smolder spikes at Q upgrade thresholds (25, 125, 225). Crit items scale him. He's a late-game hypercarry who needs to stack.

passive.name: Dragon Practice
passive.summary: Q hits permanently stack; stacks upgrade abilities at thresholds.
passive.details: Hitting champions with abilities grants Smolder stacks. At certain thresholds (25, 125, 225), his abilities gain bonus effects.

abilities.name: Super Scorcher Breath
abilities.summary: Fire a bolt at a target; evolves with stacks.
abilities.details: Smolder breathes fire at a target, dealing damage. At 25 stacks: creates an explosion. At 125: adds a burn. At 225: deals bonus true damage.

abilities.name: Achooo!
abilities.summary: Sneeze fire that slows; explodes after a delay.
abilities.details: Smolder sneezes fire at a location, slowing enemies. After a delay, it explodes dealing more damage.

abilities.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
abilities.summary: Dash forward, briefly flying over terrain.
abilities.details: Smolder dashes and gains flight, ignoring terrain for a short distance.

abilities.name: MMOOOMMMM!
abilities.summary: Call mom to fire a massive global wave.
abilities.details: Smolder calls his mother, who fires a massive wave across the map dealing damage to enemies hit. Slows and reveals enemies.
